coder_notes: Only investigational product is an autologous CAR-T cell therapy (excluded intervention type), so no pharmacological candidate (fails S6). Rituximab (5-10 days pre-infusion) and unnamed lymphodepletion chemotherapy are preparation for the cell therapy; rituximab listed as supportive (R6), lymphodepleting agents not named so not listed. EGFRvIII-positive / EGFR-amplified EGFRvIII-negative and MGMT-unmethylated requirements define arms (enrichment); they match the CAR-T target but the CAR-T is not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. Glioblastoma named in conditions and inclusion criteria; no IDH/WHO reference (cns5 unclear).
